title: Building a research-software catalog with a coding agent: from hackathon prototype to public deployment
abstract: arXiv:2609.04711v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI and coding agents can accelerate research software development, but they also increase the need for efficient software discovery and maintenance. We developed a repository catalog during a three-day hackathon and subsequently examined the engineering required to make it suitable for public deployment, including adversarial review, data-quality checks, browser-level validation, and publication safeguards. We then explored whether the lessons learned from this prototype could be transferred to a much larger, human-curated portal, through a retrieval agent under development for MateriApps that combines curated portal metadata, external documentation, vector search, and local language-model generation. translated_title: 使用编码代理构建研究软件目录：从黑客马拉松原型到公开部署
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能与编码代理能够加速研究软件的开发，但同时也增加了对高效软件发现与维护的需求。我们在一场为期三天的黑客马拉松中开发了一个软件仓库目录，随后研究了使其适合公开部署所需的工程工作，包括对抗性审查、数据质量检查、浏览器级验证以及发布保障措施。接着，我们探讨了从该原型中汲取的经验教训能否迁移到一个规模大得多的人工策划门户，即为 MateriApps 正在开发的检索代理，它结合了人工策划的门户元数据、外部文档、向量搜索和本地语言模型生成。借助编码代理的实现非常迅速，但要实现可靠运行则需要大量额外的工程投入：最为关键的问题并非程序崩溃，而是那些产生看似合理却不完整结果的静默失败。
tldr: 本研究用编码代理在三天黑客马拉松中快速构建了研究软件目录，并揭示从原型到可靠公开部署需要大量额外工程以防范静默失败，同时将经验迁移到 MateriApps 检索代理的开发中。
en_tdlr: A research-software catalog built rapidly with coding agents during a hackathon required substantial additional engineering—especially guarding against silent failures—to achieve reliable public deployment, with lessons transferred to a retrieval agent for the MateriApps portal.
